items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: well I knew Larry Shields and Harry Shields both of me

ctx.x: You know who I'm talking about. The trumpet player. The trumpet player, yeah. Yeah, I'm a player too. I think he was in the French market then.

There were a lot of guys that, well I knew Larry Shields and Harry Shields both of me. And I met some of the original bands, what was Tony Spargo, did he just recently Dialogue or something? Yeah. Yeah. What was his real name, I can't think of it now. Spargo. Yeah, some kind of name, but I know his name was Spargo. But when I first went to New York, he was up there yet. And there was a trombone player, Edwards, who was up in New York. He was still there then? He was still in New York when I went to New York,…
